dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,65)>Hmm. Actually, I can kinda sense them around already.

<$voicel(2,1)><$emotion(2,31)>They REALLY love playing with other Pokémon, <$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,51)>so if they
haven’t found anybody else, I bet they’re super bored.

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>There’s a <$cdef(27)>big, broken bridge over there, and I think that
Pokémon’s past there somewhere!

<$facial(2,5)><$motion(2,838)><$comeff(2,21)><$voicel(2,9)>Oooh, you met <$cdef(27)><$cname(554)>? YAY! If they need anything, make
sure to help ’em out!
